notes: Partial-chunk translation for live conversation: a brief mid-speech pause translates the chunk at once (confirmed-prefix stability rule, suffix only, never re-speaks a corrected prefix), then the next chunk too, chaining; chunks queue through the existing speak-while-listening queue during playback and throttle after a 429/failure until the next final. Battery: idle restart gap after 6 silent sessions (2s, never while speaking/queued, never in the first minute) plus mic-level broadcasts gated to screen-on; locked listening still needs the wake lock + mic, so savings are modest by design. v1.19 exact-match caches unchanged. Provider selector from v1.18 unchanged (Auto/Google/MyMemory/Microsoft with user-entered key, DeepL disabled - Burmese unconfirmed). No new permission, no new STT engine, no internal-audio capture, no voice commands, no model download. Chunk latency + battery are phone-unproven - the phone test decides.
